title: The New Life
description: A Vanilla+ 26.1.2 survival Minecraft server for people 16+. Enjoy a mature, small, friendly community, similar to HermitCraft.
body:
**_A Vanilla+ 26.1.2 survival Minecraft server for people 16+. 
Enjoy a mature, small, friendly community, similar to HermitCraft. Pre-whitelist today!_**

 
 **LOOKING FOR NEW PEOPLE! - JOIN US FOR OUR CIVILIZATIONS THEMED, SEASON 3!!**
 
**The New Life SMP** is a **dedicated Whitelist Community** Minecraft server **without the Bloat** that is on other Minecraft servers, such as TPA, /home, /enderchest. We support **Bedrock and Java.**
The server has begun to become **very popular** over the past few months. **Averaging 20-30 Online players** on weekends (and even some weekdays). We really have a **kind and friendly community**.

**Our New Season is open to new applicants!** We're looking for active, mature members who want to meet new people and be part of a blossoming community through our Discord and through Minecraft.

- Fully Trust Based Gameplay. No need for Claims.
- People are friendly
- Small server where you can get to know people

**The New Life** is the **perfect vanilla+ SMP** experience, and **Simple voicechat** only makes player interaction more immersive.
To join the server you will need to fill out a whitelist application, but it's worth it, and **I hope you guys can be part of it.**

**So what are you waiting for, join below!**

https://discord.gg/utB6tCstun
